payload.name: Behavioral Momentum
payload.fact: Behavioral momentum is a phenomenon where learned behavior varies in its resistance to change based on the rate of reinforcement.
payload.boundary: The phenomenon is analyzed in the context of operant conditioning and reinforcement schedules.

provenance.title: THE ANALYSIS OF BEHAVIORAL MOMENTUM
provenance.quote_or_locus: Learned behavior varies in its resistance to change, depending on the rate of reinforcement. Resistance to change may be characterized as behavioral momentum
